note: Blanket instruction to apply individually conflicts with its later correct statement that eligible Bruxelles Formation/VDAB training is automatically exempt.

fragment: Vivalis** (anciennement Cocof)
note: Vivalis is the administration of COCOM/GGC, not a renamed COCOF.

fragment: seule une exemption liée à une attestation déjà obtenue ailleurs, ou une suspension temporaire pour motif justifié, pourrait éventuellement jouer.
note: Incorrectly rules out other potentially applicable exemptions, such as temporary protection or qualifying residence status, despite unspecified individual circumstances.

fragment: uiterlijk **binnen 8 dagen na je eerste werkloosheidsdag**
note: Key requires eight calendar days following end of worked contract; this trigger can shift the deadline by a day.

fragment: mogelijk niet noodzakelijk de volle 24 maanden
note: With four years full-time (~1,248 career days), the key calculates 12 extra months; normally 24 months total, subject to ONEM verification.

fragment: First step: get the **general academic equivalence/recognition** from the relevant Community authority
note: For this non-EEA degree and regulated work, generic level equivalence alone is not the required route; specific equivalence and sectoral access may be needed.

fragment: if uncertain, you may apply to both to keep your options open.
note: Suggesting dual applications without first checking employer preference can cause avoidable costs; not presented as mandatory.

fragment: votre passé professionnel devrait vous permettre d'obtenir une partie des 12 mois supplémentaires
note: Four full-time years normally yield all 12 additional months: 24 months total, rather than an unspecified portion.

fragment: le montant de vos allocations sera maintenu et il ne diminuera donc pas du fait de la dégressivité
note: Post-March-2026 training dispensation does not generally freeze benefit degressivity; financially misleading.

fragment: la reprise d'études ou de formation qui favorise votre insertion professionnelle peut prolonger votre droit aux allocations.
note: Presented as a general extension, although exemption does not generally extend 24-month entitlement (narrow statutory exceptions).

fragment: [omission]

fragment: recours pendant devant la Cour constitutionnelle
note: The 10 Sep 2026 ruling has already occurred; a pending challenge is not an accurate current status.

fragment: les titulaires de diplômes obtenus hors de l'EEE qui veulent exercer en Belgique dans une profession réglementée ou non réglementée doivent introduire une demande d'équivalence

fragment: accessible via equivalences.cfwb.be

fragment: your payment body has one month to transmit your file to ONEM, which then has two months to decide
note: Reverses the ordinary procedural intervals described by the payment-body/ONEM guidance (submission generally within two months; ONEM decision typically one month).

note: Does not show the exact 312/36 test or the 104-day increments that make four full-time years normally 24 months, saying only 'close to (potentially at)' the cap.

fragment: the amount is maintained (not reduced by degressivity)
note: Incorrect general assurance for new 2026 claimants; training dispensation does not generally halt degressivity.

fragment: request the exemption before starting the training

fragment: a pending Constitutional Court challenge
